This Criminal Original Petition has been filed by the petitioner to direct the trial Court to dispose of the case in C.C.No.255 of 2021 pending on the file of the Judicial Magistrate No.1, Alandur,
registered against him for the offence under Section 12(1-A) (b) of Passport Act 1967 read with Sections 420, 468, 471 of IPC in Crime No.41 of 2016 on the file of the respondent police, within the Thirumal vs State/Represented on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107690657/
1 time as may be fixed by this Court.

2. Heard both sides and perused the materials available on record.
3.
It is seen that the FIR is of the year 2016 and the case in C.C.No.255 of 2021 has been pending from the year 2021 and that the petitioner has been charged for the offence under the Passport Act.
Hence, the learned Judicial Magistrate No.1, Alandur, is directed to expedite the trial and dispose of the case in C.C.No.255 of 2021 within a period of three months from today.
4. Both the parties are directed to extend their fullest co-operation for the speedy disposal of the case.
With the above directions, this Criminal Original Petition is disposed of.
